module_summary: Motor-control Moore FSM: a 4-bit state register pulses f after reset, detects x sequence 1-0-1, then drives g and latches it based on y.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Nine-state register sequencing f pulse, x 101 detection and y-qualified g hold.

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: Motor control output decoded from states G1, G2 and P1.

anchors.name: f
anchors.why: One-cycle motor control output decoded from state B after reset.

groups.name: motor_fsm
groups.description: State register, x/y-driven next-state logic and f/g output decode.
